These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-16|USDT Payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

Stripe and PayPal are convenient for creators in supported countries, offering a range of payment processing services. However, their limitations in terms of geographical reach and account suspension policies leave many creators seeking alternatives. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, provides a comprehensive solution, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and automatic crypto payment verification, giving creators full control over their digital businesses.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Creators in restricted countries face significant barriers when trying to sell digital products through platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy. These platforms often rely on Stripe or PayPal for payment processing, which can be inaccessible. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH are designed specifically for creators in these regions, providing a viable alternative that bypasses traditional payment gateways.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with full control over their digital businesses.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the emphasis on creator ownership and automation. With solutions like COREMERCH, creators have full control over their store and products, and the automation of payment verification and product delivery ensures a seamless customer experience. This approach eliminates the risk of platform dependency and account suspension, providing long-term stability for digital businesses.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Cryptocurrency payments offer a viable alternative to traditional payment gateways.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore how COREMERCH's solutions can empower your digital business, regardless of your location.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, integrate a payment verification system like NOWPayments. After that, configure your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, automate your product delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and ensure your domain's email authentication is set up with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for professional email communications.

How do I ensure the security of my digital store?
Implement robust security measures such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email authentication, and utilize secure hosting and payment processing solutions to protect your store and customer data.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Benefits include full ownership and control over your digital store, automation of payment and delivery processes, lower fees, and increased stability and security compared to traditional payment platforms.
